text_en: It happened at that time that Judah went down from his brothers and settled near a certain Adullamite whose name was Hirah.
text_cn: 那时犹大离开自己的兄弟，下到一个名叫希辣的阿杜蓝人那里住下了。

text_en: There Judah saw the daughter of a certain Canaanite whose name was Shua; he married her and went in to her.
text_cn: 犹大在那里看见了一个名叫叔亚的客纳罕人的女儿，就娶了她，亲近了她。

text_en: She conceived and bore a son; and he named him Er.
text_cn: 她遂怀孕，生了一个儿子，给他起名叫厄尔。

text_en: Again she conceived and bore a son whom she named Onan.
text_cn: 她又怀孕，生了一个儿子，给他起名敖难。

text_en: Yet again she bore a son, and she named him Shelah. She was in Chezib when she bore him.
text_cn: 以后她又生了一个儿子，给他起名叫舍拉；生他的时候，犹大正在革齐布。

text_en: Judah took a wife for Er his firstborn; her name was Tamar.
text_cn: 犹大给自己的长子厄尔娶了妻子，名叫塔玛尔。

text_en: But Er, Judah’s firstborn, was wicked in the sight of the Lord , and the Lord put him to death.
text_cn: 犹大的长子厄尔行了上主所厌恶的事，上主就叫他死了。

text_en: Then Judah said to Onan, “Go in to your brother’s wife and perform the duty of a brother-in-law to her; raise up offspring for your brother. ”
text_cn: 于是犹大对敖难说：“你去与你哥哥的妻子亲近，与她尽你为弟弟的义务，给你哥哥立后。”

text_en: But since Onan knew that the offspring would not be his, he spilled his semen on the ground whenever he went in to his brother’s wife, so that he would not give offspring to his brother.
text_cn: 敖难明知后裔不归自己，所以当他与哥哥的妻子结合时，便将精液遗泄于地，免得给自己的哥哥立后。

text_en: What he did was displeasing in the sight of the Lord , and he put him to death also.
text_cn: 他作这事，为上主所厌恶，上主就叫他死了。

text_en: Then Judah said to his daughter-in-law Tamar, “Remain a widow in your father’s house until my son Shelah grows up”—for he feared that he too would die, like his brothers. So Tamar went to live in her father’s house.
text_cn: 犹大于是对儿媳塔玛尔说：“你回到你父亲家中去守寡，直到我儿子舍拉长大成人。”因为他心里想：“恐怕他也如同他哥哥们一样死去。”塔玛尔就回去，住在自己父亲的家里。

text_en: In course of time the wife of Judah, Shua’s daughter, died; when Judah’s time of mourning was over, he went up to Timnah to his sheepshearers, he and his friend Hirah the Adullamite.
text_cn: 过了几年，犹大的妻子叔亚的女儿死了。丧期过后，犹大便同自己的朋友阿杜蓝人希辣，上提默纳黑去剪羊毛。

text_en: When Tamar was told, “Your father-in-law is going up to Timnah to shear his sheep, ”
text_cn: 有人告诉塔玛尔说：“你公公现正上提默纳黑去剪羊毛。”

text_en: she put off her widow’s garments, put on a veil, wrapped herself up, and sat down at the entrance to Enaim, which is on the road to Timnah. She saw that Shelah was grown up, yet she had not been given to him in marriage.
text_cn: 塔玛尔遂脱去守寡的衣服，蒙上首帕，遮掩自己，坐在通往提默纳黑大道去厄纳殷的路口上；──原来她见舍拉已经长大，还没有娶她为妻。──

text_en: When Judah saw her, he thought her to be a prostitute, for she had covered her face.
text_cn: 犹大一看见她，以为她是个妓女，因为她遮盖了自己的脸。

text_en: He went over to her at the roadside, and said, “Come, let me come in to you, ” for he did not know that she was his daughter-in-law. She said, “What will you give me, that you may come in to me? ”
text_cn: 犹大便由路上转到她面前，向她说：“来！让我与你亲近！”他并不知她就是自己的儿媳。她答说：“你给我什么，好与我亲近？”

text_en: He answered, “I will send you a kid from the flock. ” And she said, “Only if you give me a pledge, until you send it. ”
text_cn: 犹大答说：“由羊群中取一只小公山羊送给你。”塔玛尔说：“你未送来以前，你应给我个抵押。”

text_en: He said, “What pledge shall I give you? ” She replied, “Your signet and your cord, and the staff that is in your hand. ” So he gave them to her, and went in to her, and she conceived by him.
text_cn: 犹大问说：“我该给你什么作抵押”？她答说：“你的印章，你的系印带和你手中的棍杖。”犹大便交给了她，与她亲近了；她于是由他怀了孕。

text_en: Then she got up and went away, and taking off her veil she put on the garments of her widowhood.
text_cn: 事后，她起来回家，除掉首帕，再穿上她守寡的衣服。

text_en: When Judah sent the kid by his friend the Adullamite, to recover the pledge from the woman, he could not find her.
text_cn: 犹大托自己的朋友阿杜蓝人送了一只小公山羊去，好由那女人手中取回抵押；他却找不到她，

text_en: He asked the townspeople, “Where is the temple prostitute who was at Enaim by the wayside? ” But they said, “No prostitute has been here. ”
text_cn: 便问当地人说：“那在厄纳殷路旁的庙妓在哪里？”人答说：“这里从来没有庙妓。”

text_en: So he returned to Judah, and said, “I have not found her; moreover the townspeople said, ‘No prostitute has been here. ’”
text_cn: 他回来对犹大说：“我找不着她，并且当地的人都说：这里从来没有庙妓。”

text_en: Judah replied, “Let her keep the things as her own, otherwise we will be laughed at; you see, I sent this kid, and you could not find her. ”
text_cn: 犹大遂说：“让她留着吧！免得我们被人嗤笑。我将小公山羊送了去，可是你没有找着她。”

text_en: About three months later Judah was told, “Your daughter-in-law Tamar has played the whore; moreover she is pregnant as a result of whoredom. ” And Judah said, “Bring her out, and let her be burned. ”
text_cn: 大约过了三个月，有人告诉犹大说：“你的儿媳塔玛尔与人通奸，而且因通奸有了身孕。”犹大说：“把她拉出来烧死！”

text_en: As she was being brought out, she sent word to her father-in-law, “It was the owner of these who made me pregnant. ” And she said, “Take note, please, whose these are, the signet and the cord and the staff. ”
text_cn: 当她被拉出来时，她派人到她公公那里说：“这些东西是谁的，我就是由谁怀了孕。”并且说：“请你仔细看看这些东西：印章、印带和棍杖是谁的？”

text_en: Then Judah acknowledged them and said, “She is more in the right than I, since I did not give her to my son Shelah. ” And he did not lie with her again.
text_cn: 犹大仔细一看，就说：“她比我更有理，因为我尚没有将她嫁给我的儿子舍拉。”他从此以后，再没有认识她。

text_en: When the time of her delivery came, there were twins in her womb.
text_cn: 到了她要生产的时候，腹中竟是一对双胎。

text_en: While she was in labor, one put out a hand; and the midwife took and bound on his hand a crimson thread, saying, “This one came out first. ”
text_cn: 她正生产时，一个胎儿伸出一手来，收生婆就拿了一根朱红线系在他手上说：“这个是先出生的。”

text_en: But just then he drew back his hand, and out came his brother; and she said, “What a breach you have made for yourself! ” Therefore he was named Perez.
text_cn: 但是他一收回手去，他的兄弟就出生了；收生婆说：“你为自己开了个怎样的裂口！”遂给他起名叫培勒兹。

text_en: Afterward his brother came out with the crimson thread on his hand; and he was named Zerah.
text_cn: 以后，那手上系有朱红线的兄弟也出生了，遂给他起名叫则辣黑。
